correctness.rationale: Independently built lexicographic GP(n,2) edges and all matching faces by incremental edge inclusion. For ascending toggles the augmented face totals are 3418, 10990, 34880; directed Hasse relations total 14329, 52712, 187857, with a full topological order in every case. The critical cells after restriction to the nonempty face poset are a vertex plus counts (2,30), (11,25), (57,15) in degrees (3,4), (4,5), (5,6). Restriction drops the empty face and its matching arrow; its paired vertex becomes critical and the remaining oriented Hasse graph is a subgraph of the certified acyclic one. Recomputed each integer Morse column by topologically ordered sparse subtraction of the matched upper simplicial boundaries at matched-lower unit incidences, then discarding matched uppers of the target degree. Integral elimination has 2,9,15 unit pivots and zero residual matrices. Descending order independently yields the same wedge multiplicities. The CW skeleton below its upper cells is a wedge of d-spheres. Hurewicz identifies each attaching class with its degree vector, and the resulting map of wedges has the Morse CW type as its homotopy cofiber. Integral basis changes are realized by homotopy equivalences of the two wedges; unit diagonal summands have contractible cofiber and zero columns attach trivially. Hence these are integral homotopy types, not just homology ranks.
residual_risks: The frozen script only tabulates expected forward counts and filters positive critical dimensions; the independent computation counts every critical dimension and checks both orders. No assertion for higher n, equivariance or periodicity follows.
